svg.text: LA HABRA HEIGHTS FIRE WATCH · COM-03 · DRAFT

g.text: SAMPLE TEXT — NOT APPROVED ADVICE. This page demonstrates layout and must
receive editorial and subject-matter review before use.
Move to a safe location first. Replace this sample with verified instructions
from the responsible agency.
Before making a report
Describe your location and where the smoke or fire appears to be.
Note only what you can observe safely: visible smoke or flame, apparent
direction, and nearby landmarks.
Do not approach a hazard to collect more details.
Details to have ready
Your callback information, if requested
Where and when you observed the condition
What is changing, if anything
A safe route away from the area
Reporting method: [VERIFY AND INSERT OFFICIAL LOCAL INSTRUCTIONS]
Do not insert a number, frequency, or agency endorsement without documented
review.
DIAGRAM PLACEHOLDER — location / landmark sketch pattern
PLACEHOLDER: Add current agency guidance, URL, publication date, and access
date.
